title: Review-round nits from QCLI-525/526/527/528, and QCLI-525's superseded AC prose
description:
Nits recorded by the DeepSeek reviewer units for the four tasks landed on 2026-10-22 (opum-ai/quest-cli#667 QCLI-528, #668 QCLI-526, #669 QCLI-525, #670 QCLI-527), plus QCLI-525's superseded AC prose. Each was deliberately left out of the reviewed heads. This is the single bucket so none is lost. Line numbers were measured on dev tip 034907cf96026094cc4f5ba28392fc625254c560; the named symbols are the durable pointer.

#667 / QCLI-528 (lock-read split):
1. The "NaN age" rationale at src/application/tasks/id-allocation.ts:425-429 and in that PR's body is wrong: `now() - null` yields now(), an age that reads as maximally stale, not NaN. The guard itself is right; only the stated mechanism is wrong. This is the one most worth correcting.
2. The `existing.at !== null` guard at id-allocation.ts:503 is unreachable.
3. The unstat-able hint (id-allocation.ts:230-239) does not tell the operator to measure the age.
4. One over-long line in CHANGELOG.md:62 (92 columns measured here, about 89 reported).
5. src/application/agents/guides.ts:213-216 does not mention the unstat-able case, though the statement there is still true.

#668 / QCLI-526 (release on failure):
1. AC4's "one place" overclaims: src/application/checks/continuity.ts:33 and src/application/tasks/local-task-repository.ts:190-194 still hold copies of the location list.
2. Nothing pins N5's "Retry the command" hint.
3. The source-fingerprint return path has no test.
4. A failed release on the two return paths (src/application/migration/backlog-public.ts:1183 and :1196) is silently dropped, and `cause` cannot be reached through the CLI envelope.
5. The bookkeeping window at backlog-public.ts:839 and id-allocation.ts:795-798.

#670 / QCLI-527 (ref follow-ups):
1. CHANGELOG.md:24 says all five failure outcomes name the ref and sha, but the conflict outcome (task_reference_ambiguous, src/cli/main.ts:5079) names neither. Soften the clause, or attach {ref, sha} to the conflict mapping.
2. The comment at continuity.ts:31-38 overstates the unification: two same-named lists survive at local-task-repository.ts:190-194 and backlog-public.ts:760-761 (the second is #668's N6 target). Name them rather than claiming one home.
3. The `status === "To Do"` assertions at test/qcli519-task-view-at-ref.test.ts:310 and :319 do not discriminate, because the fixture's working tree is dev. Put the tag on `feature` and assert "In Progress".

QCLI-525 record prose (record-only):
- implementationNotes[0]'s closing "NOTE on AC wording" and the finalSummary still say the AC text pairs each case with the mutant that keeps the same half and that the attribution reads inverted. QCLI-525's ACs were corrected in #669 (e0a5955c) to name the STAMP-keeping and PID-keeping mutants correctly, so both passages now describe a state the record no longer holds. Reword them to record the corrected attribution without contradicting the ACs.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every item in the description is either fixed, with the check that proves it recorded in the notes, or explicitly declined with the reason.
